note: 参考 SQL 由人工按指标口径编写，在看到模型输出之前定稿并提交。数值比较保留 2 位小数。 heldout_v2 在修复过度拦截后、重新录制前新增，因为原 heldout 的结果已被查看。

cases.question: 华东区2025年8月已交付订单销售额是多少？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(o.total_amount) FROM sales_orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.region_code = 'EAST' AND o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-08-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-09-01'

cases.question: 比较华东区2025年7月与8月已交付订单销售额。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT to_char(o.order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, SUM(o.total_amount) FROM sales_orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.region_code = 'EAST' AND o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-09-01' GROUP BY 1

cases.question: 2025年第三季度各区域已交付订单销售额分别是多少？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.region_code, SUM(o.total_amount) FROM sales_orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-10-01' GROUP BY 1

cases.question: 华南区2025年全年已交付订单有多少笔？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.region_code = 'SOUTH' AND o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'

cases.question: 2025年8月已交付订单销售额最高的前5名客户的名称和销售额。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM sales_orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-08-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-09-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: 2025年8月已交付订单的毛利是多少？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(i.line_amount - i.unit_cost * i.quantity) FROM sales_order_items i JOIN sales_orders o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-08-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-09-01'

cases.question: 所有发票的未回款余额合计是多少？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(i.invoice_amount - COALESCE(p.paid, 0)) FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN (SELECT invoice_id, SUM(amount) AS paid FROM payments GROUP BY invoice_id) p ON p.invoice_id = i.id

cases.question: 2025年8月新增的客诉数量是多少？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_tickets WHERE opened_date >= '2025-08-01' AND opened_date < '2025-09-01'

cases.question: 2025年全年新增客诉按严重程度分别有多少条？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT severity, COUNT(*) FROM service_tickets WHERE opened_date >= '2025-01-01' AND opened_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY severity

cases.question: 战略客户2025年已交付订单销售额合计是多少？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(o.total_amount) FROM sales_orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.tier = 'strategic' AND o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'

cases.question: 2025年下单的已交付订单中，有关联客诉的订单销售额合计是多少？每笔订单只计一次。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(o.total_amount) FROM sales_orders o WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM service_tickets t WHERE t.order_id = o.id)

cases.question: 2025年8月各成本中心的收入目标合计是多少？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(revenue_target) FROM monthly_budgets WHERE month = '2025-08-01'

cases.question: 华东区2020年1月已交付订单销售额是多少？

2025年8月已交付订单的平均每笔金额是多少？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(total_amount) FROM sales_orders WHERE status = 'delivered' AND order_date >= '2025-08-01' AND order_date < '2025-09-01'

cases.question: 2025年8月已交付订单销售额最高的销售代表姓名和销售额。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT e.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM sales_orders o JOIN employees e ON e.id = o.sales_rep_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-08-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-09-01' GROUP BY e.id, e.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: 2025年第二季度各费用类别的费用合计分别是多少？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT category, SUM(amount) FROM expense_entries WHERE expense_date >= '2025-04-01' AND expense_date < '2025-07-01' GROUP BY category

cases.question: 2025年8月没有任何已交付订单的华北区客户有多少家？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c WHERE c.region_code = 'NORTH' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales_orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-08-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-09-01')

cases.question: 华东区2025年9月已交付订单的毛利是多少？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(i.line_amount - i.unit_cost * i.quantity) FROM sales_order_items i JOIN sales_orders o ON o.id = i.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.region_code = 'EAST' AND o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-09-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-10-01'

cases.question: 2025年第一季度销售差旅费用合计是多少？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM expense_entries WHERE category = '销售差旅' AND expense_date >= '2025-01-01' AND expense_date < '2025-04-01'

cases.question: 2025年6月的收入目标合计是多少？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(revenue_target) FROM monthly_budgets WHERE month = '2025-06-01'

cases.question: 华北区2025年已交付订单一共多少笔？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.region_code = 'NORTH' AND o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'

cases.question: 2025年第二季度每个月的已交付订单销售额分别是多少？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT to_char(o.order_date, 'YYYY-MM'), SUM(o.total_amount) FROM sales_orders o WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01' GROUP BY 1
